records.claim: Frequency is a rate of recurrence measured in inverse seconds; the SI special name is hertz.
records.evidence_note: NIST time/frequency references

records.claim: A numerical frequency alone does not identify the physical nature of a phenomenon.
records.evidence_note: Compare acoustic, EM, phonon, matter-wave, and GW sources below

records.claim: Ordinary sound in air involves mechanical pressure/density variation and requires matter.
records.evidence_note: NIST acoustics

records.claim: Maxwell's equations support electromagnetic-wave propagation; a material medium is not required in vacuum.
records.evidence_note: Maxwell electrodynamics; NIST reference

records.claim: Radio through gamma radiation are regions of the electromagnetic spectrum rather than separate fundamental media.
records.evidence_note: Electrodynamics / standard spectrum classifications

records.claim: Crystal lattice vibrations form normal modes; quantized excitations of such modes are phonons.
records.evidence_note: Lattice-dynamics literature

records.claim: Molecular rotational transitions are observed in radio/microwave/millimeter-wave spectroscopy.
records.evidence_note: NIST molecular spectral databases

records.claim: Molecular and condensed-phase vibrational dynamics can occur in infrared/terahertz spectral regions; exact values are system- and mode-dependent.
records.evidence_note: Spectroscopy reviews

records.claim: Electron diffraction demonstrates wave behavior of matter consistent with de Broglie-type matter waves.
records.evidence_note: Davisson–Germer

records.claim: Gravitational radiation forms a spectrum physically distinct from electromagnetic radiation and can share numerical frequency ranges with other wave types.
records.evidence_note: Living Reviews in Relativity

records.claim: "Heat" is not one wave family or single frequency band; thermal transport/radiation can involve multiple mechanisms.
records.evidence_note: Thermodynamics + phononics + blackbody radiation

records.claim: For photons, `E = hf`; frequency alone does not determine the total energy of an arbitrary classical wave.
records.evidence_note: Quantum theory + classical wave mechanics

records.claim: The Standard Model is formulated using quantum field theory; particles can be described as excitations of quantum fields.
records.evidence_note: PDG / CERN QFT references

records.claim: The microscopic identity of dark matter is unknown; some ultralight bosonic candidate models predict coherent/wave-like oscillatory signals searchable in frequency space.
records.evidence_note: Atomic-clock and cavity searches

records.claim: A gap in detector sensitivity is not automatically a gap in physical existence, and an empty visual frequency interval does not by itself predict new physics.
records.evidence_note: Multi-band GW literature; evidence policy

records.claim: The repository currently has no empirical basis for treating all phenomena as one universal physical vibration or one common propagation medium.
records.evidence_note: Existing theories distinguish degrees of freedom; future unification must be separately evidenced
